messages:
aline: hi all :wave: first-week question: where do I get a sandbox API key vs a hosted/prod key? also what are the default sandbox quotas and rate-limits so I can plan tests without burning credits?

chris: welcome! sandbox keys are auto-provisioned when you sign up and appear in Console -> Sandbox keys. Hosted/prod keys are created by org admins in Console -> API Keys and are billing-enabled.

ops: default sandbox tier for new hires: $30 promo credits + 50k tokens/month quota. Rate limits: ~15 requests/sec per key with a short burst allowance (up to ~60 reqs/sec for a few seconds). These numbers can vary by cohort.

aline: nice, thanks. how do I request more tokens or higher rps for load testing?

devex-bot: To request a sandbox bump, open a ticket at https://go/redwood-support (select "Sandbox quota increase") or ping @ops. For sustained load tests use a staging org or request a temporary load-testing key.

chris: note: hosted keys need org admin creation + a short security review if you request access to customer data scopes. Email security@redwood.com for that flow.

aline: any tips to avoid accidental key leaks?

ops: don't commit keys, use env vars or Vault. Example local env: export REDWOOD_API_KEY=\"sk-sandbox-xxxx\" and add to .env.local (gitignored). For CI use secrets manager. We also have a key-rotation script: `tools/rotate_key.sh`.

example curl (sandbox):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1-mini","input":"hello"}'
```

chris: if you're doing heavy token generation for experiments, prefer synthetic inputs or a staging account so you don't use the promo credits. For quick checks, the playground in Console is handy.

aline: perfect — saved. I'll open a support ticket if we need a bump. Thanks y'all! :thumbsup:
